A '''flight''', also known as a '''flight element''' or '''wingpair''', was the smallest and most basic unit within a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] formation. Made up of two starfighters and their pilots, a flight element was the basic leader-[[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]] arrangement that ensured the maximum chances of survival within a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter engagement]]. Two flight elements operating together formed a flight; rank among flight elements rarely mattered, as they would often switch positions while in combat.
